name: Exhibition Opening: Pia Camil "Sharing"
description: Be among the first to see the new outdoor installation "Partilhar" by Pia Camil, a powerful work exploring themes of community and exchange.
longDescription:
The Galeria Municipal do Porto presents the opening of "Sharing," an outdoor installation by Mexican artist Pia Camil. This new work delves into concepts of collective identity and reciprocal exchange, manifesting as a large-scale public artwork designed to engage with the urban environment and its inhabitants. Camil's practice often involves participatory elements and draws inspiration from everyday objects and social dynamics.

Visitors to the opening will be among the first to encounter the installation in its complete form. The event offers an opportunity to observe the artwork within the setting of the Galeria Municipal do Porto, an institution known for showcasing contemporary art. The atmosphere is expected to be focused on the unveiling of the piece, suitable for individuals interested in contemporary art and public interventions.

Admission to the exhibition opening is free of charge, with walk-ins welcome. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is located within walking distance of the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F).
